namespace Shop.Application.Services
{
    public class OrderService
    {
        public decimal Total(Order order)
        {
            return ApplyDiscounts(order.Lines, order.CustomerTier);
        }

        private decimal ApplyDiscounts(IEnumerable<OrderLine> lines, int tier)
        {
            decimal total = 0;
            foreach (var line in lines)
            {
                var amount = line.Quantity * line.UnitPrice;
                if (tier > 2 && amount > 100)
                {
                    amount = amount * 0.9m;
                }
                total += Math.Round(amount, 2);
            }
            return total;
        }
    }
}
